title: zazzle MCP proxy component diagram
description: The proxy's two transports share one filter, which decides which server answers to clean, with the settings the config file gives each tool, hands their texts to clean's steps and stores what it shortened for read-again. The MCP client and the upstream server are outside the repository.

components.name: zazzle MCP proxy
components.responsibility: Cleans another MCP server's tool results and resource reads on their way to the client.

components.name: Options and filter (mod.rs)
components.responsibility: Parses the proxy options; records pending tools/call and resources/read requests by id; rewrites the texts of the responses that answer them, single or batched, with the rule for their tool or for resource reads, unless skipped; stores each shortened text with its original and adds an item with its id; logs the savings with --log.

components.name: stdio transport (stdio.rs)
components.responsibility: Starts the server command as a child with stderr passed through, copies client lines to it while recording requests, copies its lines back while cleaning answers, and returns its exit code.

components.name: Streamable HTTP transport (http.rs)
components.responsibility: Listens on a TCP address and serves requests one after another on each connection until the client closes it, asks to, sends something unreadable or is idle for 60 seconds; refuses other web origins, forwards each request with its end-to-end headers to the upstream URL, and relays the answer: JSON cleaned whole, event streams cleaned per event, anything else copied; answers of unknown length are chunked on a connection kept open.

components.name: Per-tool settings (config.rs)
components.responsibility: Reads the --config JSON file, refusing unknown sections, settings and types, and gives a tool's rule by exact name or the longest matching `*` pattern, and the rule for resource reads.

components.name: Output store
components.responsibility: outputs.rs in the parent folder: keeps each shortened text with its original for an hour for read-again.

components.name: clean's steps
components.responsibility: shrink_steps and cuts: the cleaning applied to each text, and whether it cut something.

components.name: MCP client
components.responsibility: The coding agent's client, which starts `zazzle proxy -- CMD` or connects to the proxy's HTTP address.

components.name: Upstream MCP server
components.responsibility: Any MCP server: a command speaking stdio, or a Streamable HTTP endpoint.
